intro: Snellig's Snuffbox is a personal keepsake recovered from the restless undead First Mate Snellig among the wreckage of the Lost Fleet. Bringing this trinket back to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor serves as proof that his cursed former crewmate has finally been put to rest.

sections.t: A Keepsake of the Third Fleet
p: When the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras ran aground along the northern shores of the Wetlands, its sailors and officers did not find peaceful deaths. Bound by a mysterious and dark power tied to a hidden treasure aboard the ships, the drowned crew rose again as tortured spirits and skeletal undead. Among them was First Mate Snellig, who still haunts the rotting hold of the wreck closest to the coastline. Even in death, he clung to his snuffbox—a small, mundane reminder of his mortal life at sea. For the sole living survivor of the disaster, First Mate Fitzsimmons, recovering this small possession provides tangible proof that at least one of his lost shipmates has been released from an eternity of torment.
